profile.name: Jerome Whitley
profile.summary: Program analyst with eight years in public and nonprofit programs, most recently managing performance data and grant reporting for a county human services department with a $96 million budget. Applying for Management and Program Analyst positions at the GS-11 or GS-12 level.

workExperiences.company: Larkmead County Department of Human Services
descriptions: Track performance for 14 programs serving about 22,000 residents a year, including food assistance, housing support and job training
Built the department's monthly performance dashboard in Power BI, replacing 30 separate spreadsheets; leadership now reviews it at every monthly meeting
Prepare quarterly reports for four federal and state grants worth $11 million in total, all submitted on time with no findings in two federal monitoring reviews
Led a review of the emergency rental program's application process that cut average decision time from 34 days to 19 days
Write policy briefs and budget justifications for the department director and the county council, usually on a two-week turnaround
Train program staff on data entry standards and run a quarterly data quality check
Managed 18 public and private grants worth $2.4 million a year, start to finish
Wrote or co-wrote proposals that brought in $3.1 million in new funding over three years, including the organization's first federal award
Set up a grants calendar and tracking system that ended late reports, which had happened four times the year before
Worked with the finance manager on grant budgets, cost allocation and audit preparation
Collected and checked outcome data from five program sites for funder reports
Prepared the organization's first single audit with the finance manager and outside auditors; the audit closed with no findings or questioned costs
Represented the kitchen at the city's food security coalition and coordinated two joint grant applications with partner groups
Coordinated weekly food distribution at 12 partner sites serving about 3,000 households
Kept the client database current and produced monthly service reports for the board
Recruited and scheduled about 60 volunteers a month
Wrote the volunteer handbook and ran monthly orientation sessions for new volunteers
Tracked donated food by source and category for the annual report to funders and the board
Answered client calls and referred families to county and state benefit programs
Helped prepare the annual budget for the distribution program
Coursework: Program Evaluation, Public Budgeting, Policy Analysis, Statistics for Public Managers
Analysis: Excel, Power BI, SQL, Tableau
Grants: Federal grant reporting, budget review, monitoring
Languages: English (native), Spanish (professional)
